text: Death is but the beginning...
attacks you with unnatural strength!
if all outlanders fight this good, we are in trouble.
Now this, this comes as a surprise!
Your flesssh will ssserve usss well!
I can't froaking believe you froaking defeated me, you froaking scum, Froaaak!
Farg!
crumbles to the ground in a spray of reptilian blood!
Glortuk goomash clobtoga!
releases a roaring hiss and attacks!
waches your movement for a moment and attacks!
fixes its fiery gaze upon you as it moves to attack.
skitters towards you.
The Blood Tribe shall avenge my death.
I sense this will be a poor feeding, since only a fool would venture here to our lair, and the soul of a fool is meager sustenance.
falls to the floor.  You are uncertain if it is truly dead this time.
swings at you with amazing speed!
spits black blood on your armor and slithers toward you.
attacks with incredible precision!
What kind of fool enters this place uninvited?
glares at you with unblinking eyes.
Excellent, a soul to consume.
descends from the sky, crashing to its death.
Our master demands that we take your life now. Goodbye!
becomes completely still for a moment and then shatters into a thousand tiny black pebbles, pelting everyone with sharp stones.
cries out, 'Guards! Guards!'
falls forward into a heap of bones and decayed mail.
strikes at you with its feeder.
Aaarrghh!!  The Deathfist shall hunt you down.  My death will not go unnoticed.
Come feel the steel of an orc legionnaire!!
I escape Tarkiz now. . .
I see that you die swiftly.
collapses into a pool of its own blood and venom.
screams as their soul is consumed by the plane of war.
lowers its head and charges directly at you!
eyes turn red with rage, as the bird falls lifelessly to the ground.
For the glory of Marr!
My comrades will avenge my death.
falls to the ground quietly whispering a prayer to Mithaniel Marr.
The guardian falls to the ground in defeat, no longer able to protect Marr.
awakens from a deep slumber
The velium golem crumbles to the floor, broken and no longer useful to the shrine.
crackles back into death.
My death is with honor.
falls to the ground shattering into pieces.
feeds on the scrap parts around it, and begins to head in your direction!
grinds to a stop, clanking and groaning.
growls fiercely then attacks!
The Warlord will see that you pay!
Foolish mortal!  How dare you try to disturb the sanctity of the shrine!
falls to the ground with a wet thud.
You may have won, but your victory will be short lived.
I will show you the power of my gods!
You shall soon feel the daggers of the Butcherblock Bandits upon your back!!
collapses in a pile of rubble.
moves swiftly towards a new victim.
roars as it moves to attack.
comes to life before your eyes and begins to attack you.
mumbles as it falls lifeless to the ground.
twitches uncontrollably in death.
utters an apology to Mata Muram.
slumps to the ground quietly.
slides and falls in a pool of its own acidic blood.
screams to the sky as its body crumbles beneath it.
slithers through the wastes and lunges at its prey.
emits a low guttural growl as it lunges toward you.
smiles as it falls to the ground.
lumbers forth, its joints grating together creating a deafening roar.
You're going to find an arrow in your back before I'm through!
The foul scent of weaklings is near! Come meet your doom!
keels over dead from the sheer force of her opponents.
I felt your pathetic presence from afar. Now you'll be destroyed!
I won't need the Muramites commanding me to tear you down!
Ungh.. I go now to join the spirits.
chokes on blood as it collapses to the ground.
The acolyte was only a diversion, but important nonetheless. You must forge ahead to uncover the mysterious glimpses you've seen of the Guardian of Transcendence.
legs give out and it slumps to the ground.
falls to the ground with a deafening crash. Everyone in the area senses the powerful primal essence of the beast lingering for a moment before dispersing among the caves.
stomps its hooves against the ground as it stumbles lifelessly.
awakens from a deep slumber.

Young one, you cannot fathom how long it has been since I breathed air and felt flesh on my bones. I told you I would show you a weapon that would make you the most powerful of your kind. I said nothing of giving it to you. Feast your eyes on Innoruuk's Curse, mortal! Thank you for your service.
You dare insult an IceBear?!
What madness is this? How could I have been defeated? I beg of you Xegony, please forgive my weakness.
This is not over, fools. My death here is merely the beginning. I will return to you in your most horrible nightmares!
Your kind have invaded my home for long enough. If you thought you knew what hate was before, I have one last lesson to teach you!
Why do you even bother to challenge our power?  You can not win.

Hullo!!  Me is Boomba.  Me make da bestest pickles in da Norrath. Me gots da dwarfies. da halflings. da humies - me even gots da pixie pickles!!  Of course all of dem were baddies from da dunjuns.  Da guards say it gud ta pickle da baddies.
sniffs at the air, sensing prey nearby.
Grrrraaaaarrrrrg! The stench of fear permeates the walls of this city! I will forge one item for the faithful of our Lord Cazic-Thule! Make haste!  My time here is short!
circles in, brandishing a wicked looking smile.
You dare confront me?!  All attack!
explodes into a shower of sparks.

You have done very well, . You must now travel to the heart of the discord-filled lands and obtain an Globe of Discordant Energy. It is only after the menace has been stopped can we begin to live anew. If you succeed, return to Vortix. He will know what to do. Hurry for time is of the essence...
You shall never get my testimony. I shall fight you from the grave!! Ha Ha Ha!! You cannot stop the undead!! Foolish mortal!! Your foul deeds have earned my contempt.
You dare to challenge the piercing judgment of decay?
You truly believe you can defeat a creature of such ancient power and knowledge? Fools, all of you!
I will collect your soul for my lord.
falls, blood radiating outward from its corpse.
bobs on the air as it attacks.
goes limp and falls almost gracefully to the ground.
yelps in pain.
is motionless, trapped in this reality.
Nothing but mulch for the forest.
clatters to the ground, finally at rest.
Tiktakiyiyiyi!
's corpse crumbles to a dust that leaves no trace of its former grandeur.
Black blood pools on the floor where the broken banshee lies.
's corpse staggers, then falls hard to the ground, whatever animating force it possessed now lost.
lets out one last breath as its life force slips away.
Yitititi!  Look!  Aiyi, maka rik ro ne vis ka Vaniki!  Someone dares challenge Vaniki!
Viyiyiyi!
roars as it tosses back its head and attacks you
Perhaps this death will release my soul from this accursed place.
What?!?  I should have easily evaded that blow!
Feel the rage of our master!
Rrrrrowwrrrr!!  For the great spirit of our ancestor, Kejaan, I shall rid our lands of your vile presence!
My comrades will avenge my death.
lunges, baring its fang.
Your blood shall stain the flora of this sylvan wood!!  For King Naythox and the glory of the Neriak Empire!!!
My brothers of the Stormguard shall avenge me!!  Your days are numbered!
And to think I thought it was safe to live in the plains.
grumbles and looks up at you.
Karana, protect me in battle!!
Halt!  You are an enemy of the people of Qeynos!  Stop in the name of Antonius Bayle and prepare for punishment!
Ooh... Aaah!! No! Please! Ouch.... Aarghhhhh!
I wiggled my fingers and waved my hands.  But there is no glory in failed last stands!
My brothers of the Stormguard shall avenge me!!  Your days are numbered!
Invaders!!  To arms, my fellow guardsmen!  Defend the Keep!  Protect the Dain!

Well now, look what you have done here!  Dead I am, as I knew I would be, if not a bit sooner than I would have liked.. But a rotting carcass upon the ground is no fit end for a Dragon.  Grant me this boon, take my heart and hurl it into the fire in the Necropolis, so that my ashes may fly free.
I've gotta stop Gragbar before he turns in that report!
runs at you full force, its body ready to crush into you.
Inhabitants of the forests, come to my side!
To arms! Fend off the intruders and halt their attempts to proceed any further!
Our slumber has been disturbed, the use of arcane tools is authorized.
slumps over dead.
rolls over letting out its last breath as it falls victim to its mortal wounds.
You shall soon feel the daggers of the Butcherblock Bandits upon your back!!
Death!! Death to all who oppose the Crushbone orcs!!
squeaks as it wanders.
The Priests of Marr will not overlook my death.  I pity you.
screeches loudly and charges leaving a trail of deep claw marks in the muddy floor.
floats belly up in the murky water.
Hiss..  You cannot hope to defeat a Crusader of Greenmist!!
Ha! You are not going to be able to stop me from poaching!
You shall fall to the might of a Combine Warrior!
moves ponderously to attack
Curse you!!  You shall have all the Haven Defenders on your head for this.
You have not won.  Consider yourself wanted by the Legion of Cabilis.
For the honor of King Grery, your heresy shall be undone!
detaches from a rock and springs toward you.
What ya want?  You wouldn't be one of them Talikars come lookin for who robbed your gran daddys grave would ya?  Hahaha.  Get lost!
Crossing the Shadel Bandits will be the ruin of you!
Hahahahahahahaha. . . DIE!
Damn!  I just had this uniform cleaned.
You are the weak that we shall cull!  We'll rip off your head and polish your skull!!
Seru Victa!
I so enjoy a spot of exercise!
Yer messin with the wrong Coldain, prepare ta meet yer ancestors!
I knew this was going to happen!
I expected as much from the likes of you.
Toes, fingers, skulls, it is all the same to me.
Wuhhh......
None shall enter the Arx!
We crush you!!  We still be centurions!!
